note: The protected set holds only sensitive code, and sensitive code lives only in the protected set. The lists of what is lock and what is ship-it live in zones.json, the one map. Lock means the files that decide who may merge what: the owner says it in chat AND the strictness check finds the change no looser. Ship-it means the owner says it in chat. Baseline is the number of sensitive lines each file holds today. It may only go down. A new sensitive line in a file that is not listed here is a change to this file, and so a change to the lock.
